text:
Non emergono contraddizioni logiche interne né discrepanze tra budget proposto e confermato, poiché il documento non presenta valori confermati distinti. L’unico dato critico è la scadenza indefinita per la pratica P04-006.

Si rilevano anomalie nei dati:
1. **Duplicazione budget**: P04-000 e P04-007 hanno lo stesso importo (7067 €) ma reparti e responsabili diversi.
2. **Incoerenza di stato**: Le pratiche "approvate" (P04-000, P04-003, P04-004, P04-007, P04-008) dipendono ancora dalla revisione del disegno, il che è logicamente incoerente con uno stato finale di approvazione.
3. **Ambiguità temporale**: La scadenza di P04-006 è "da definire", rendendo il dato incompleto rispetto alle altre righe.<|im_end|>

Look for internal contradictions and differences between proposed and confirmed budgets.

Document (fictional data):
Line 1. Elena, responsible for the building services department, reports case P04-000, status approved, budget 7067 euros, deadline 2026-11-05. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 2. Fabio, responsible for the structures department, reports case P04-001, status suspended, budget 4307 euros, deadline 2026-11-06. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 3. Giulia, responsible for the construction department, reports case P04-002, status under review, budget 975 euros, deadline 2026-11-07. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 4. Irene, responsible for the building services department, reports case P04-003, status approved, budget 4112 euros, deadline 2026-11-08. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 5. Luca, responsible for the structures department, reports case P04-004, status approved, budget 6980 euros, deadline 2026-11-09. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 6. Marta, responsible for the construction department, reports case P04-005, status suspended, budget 7572 euros, deadline 2026-11-10. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 7. Nadia, responsible for the building services department, reports case P04-006, status under review, budget 7234 euros, deadline to be defined. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 8. Paolo, responsible for the structures department, reports case P04-007, status approved, budget 7067 euros, deadline 2026-11-12. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 9. Rita, responsible for the construction department, reports case P04-008, status approved, budget 8787 euros, deadline 2026-11-13. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 10. Sara, responsible for the building services department, reports case P04-009, status suspended, budget 3235 euros, deadline 2026-11-14. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 11. The proposal to bring all deadlines forward has not been approved. The stated amounts are estimates, not actual costs.

Keep the answer concise: at most about 120 words, or the requested code or data. Do not include internal reasoning.
